notes: RBox edit that removes or changes a property the relation really has (coordinator rule: no added properties). Derived queries state the instance facts in the prompt and ask what follows, so they are determinate by construction and carry no determinacy. Yes/no answers are balanced across the topic's RBox records through phrasing ('does it follow ...?' against 'given only this fact, is it possible ...?'). Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. All instance facts are clear in the real world (R1). The second instance asks about 'is a parasite of' itself (is it possible that mice are not parasites of owls?), so its answer follows from the prompt and the edited inverse alone; an earlier version asked whether 'mice are prey of owls' still follows, which depended on whether a relation can have two inverses and on the plain meaning of 'prey of'.
